verdict.rationale: Ramp's own materials describe the full flow: a vendor invoice is dragged in, matched to its PO, coded to the right GL account, routed for approval, and paid. AI agents handle auto-coding, approval routing and automatic payment, and the agent learns from past invoices. The Bill Payments API and CLI (bills approve, purchase-orders) expose the same flow programmatically for agent-driven use. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the invoice-to-PO matching logic (it appears only as a single marketing line), independent or hands-on corroboration of automated AP matching, and bill approvals via MCP, which the docs say aren't available yet (UI or Approvals API only).
